from itertools import combinations_with_replacement

def combinations_colors(colors, n):
    # Generate all combinations (with replacement) of length n from the list colors
    return list(combinations_with_replacement(colors, n))

from itertools import product

def combinations_colors(colors, n):
    # Generate all combinations (with replacement) of length n from the list colors
    return [p for p in product(colors, repeat=n)]

# Test the function with provided data points
assert combinations_colors(["Red", "Green", "Blue"], 1) == [('Red',), ('Green',), ('Blue',)]
